card.name: Numbers and hyphens in study descriptions
card.fires_on: Numbers, hyphens and other small joining marks inside clinical study descriptions or section numbers, such as the digit after '2.' or 'three' before '-way crossover'.

modes.label: Joining marks in study text
modes.description: A hyphen, bracket or 'of' linking study names, dates or completion phrases.
